name: Steady weight change
summary: Work toward a steady weight change with weekly habit targets for meals, steps and sleep instead of crash rules.

onboarding.prompt: What kind of change are you working toward?
onboarding.reaction: Got it. We'll build habits, not crash rules.

onboarding.prompt: Is there a date you're working toward?
onboarding.reaction: Noted. Steady habits beat a rushed deadline.

phases.name: Foundations
benchmarks: Hit 3 of 5 weekly habits for 3 weeks
actions: Talk to your doctor before starting
Pick 2 meal habits (for example a vegetable at lunch, water before meals)

phases.name: Build
benchmarks: Hit 4 of 5 weekly habits for 3 weeks

plan_blueprint.calendar: A weekly check-in, a meal-planning slot, and optional walk slots. No daily weigh-in reminders; weigh-ins are optional and weekly at most.

approach_variants.habit: One tiny habit added at a time, stacked on meals already eaten; habit streaks shown.
approach_variants.willpower: Weekly habit challenge with a score out of five and a 12-week finish line.
approach_variants.time: Meal planning, shopping and walks all become calendar blocks; weekly time review.
approach_variants.reward: Owner-chosen non-food rewards at weeks 4, 8 and 12.
approach_variants.resource: Week one sets up a doctor visit, a simple shopping list, walking shoes and a water bottle.

guardrails: Talk to your doctor before starting. GoalKin offers education, not medical advice.
This is a habit plan, not a diet prescription; no calorie targets are set by GoalKin.
If eating, weight or body image feels distressing, pause the plan and reach out to a health professional.
Product, app or recipe ideas are labeled as suggestions; any affiliate link is disclosed.
Every plan item can be edited, moved or removed, and you can add your own steps.
restart_rules: Missed habits simply reset next week; there is no streak penalty. Two missed check-ins in a row prompt a lighter week with just one habit. After a month away, the plan restarts at Foundations with your previous habits pre-filled.
